summary: The customer wants assistance designing an initial feasibility study and selecting reference measurements for an optical monitoring approach to track yeast growth and metabolic changes in a broth that increases in optical density.

facts_stated.text: The customer wants an optical measurement during yeast fermentation.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: We would like an optical measurement during yeast fermentation

facts_stated.text: The team has mentioned both biomass and metabolic signals, but they are not defined as separate targets.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: Our team has mentioned both a biomass signal and a metabolic signal, but these have not been defined as separate targets.

facts_stated.text: The fermentation broth increases in optical density over time.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: The broth becomes more optically dense as the run develops.

facts_stated.text: The customer is seeking help to formulate an initial feasibility study with reference measurements.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: We need help turning this request into an initial feasibility study with useful reference measurements.

optical_regime.enquiry_quote: The broth becomes more optically dense as the run develops.

process.value: Optical density increases as the run develops
process.enquiry_quote: The broth becomes more optically dense as the run develops.

unknowns: Specific metabolic analytes of interest (e.g., glucose, ethanol, organic acids) and their expected concentration ranges
Specific biomass definition and reference method (e.g., dry cell weight, OD600, cell count, capacitance)
Vessel/bioreactor details, probe mounting port type, and immersion location
Presence and effect of aeration, sparging bubbles, or agitation on optical path
Operating temperature and pressure in the fermenter
Required response time, measurement frequency, and precision
Cleaning and sterilization requirements (e.g., CIP, SIP, autoclavable)
